about: Explore mode for Bengaluru on LOKA (atlas/explore-mode.js). Copied into the atlas's manifest.local.json by deploy/apply-explore-mode.mjs. A place belongs to a button when one of its own categories is one of the button's words; it may belong to several, or to none (it stays on the map and in the list). The buttons, their order and their words are Fable's analysis of 24 Oct 2026.
